title: Snapchat Scam UK: Fake Messages & Impersonation

claims.text: fraud alert with a credit reference agency
claims.detail: uses US-style 'fraud alert on your credit file'. The UK mechanism is a Cifas Protective Registration (cifas.org.uk); free CRA monitoring is separate.

claims.text: If the scam involved a phishing link or fake login page, you can also report it to the National Cyber Security Centre Suspicious Email Repor
claims.detail: routes a suspicious WEBSITE or link to 'report@phishing.gov.uk', which is the NCSC's Suspicious Email Reporting Service — the mailbox for suspicious EMAILS. The NCSC's own scam-website page does not mention it. Send websites and links to the ncsc-scam-website route in content/sources.json instead; texts go to 7726, run by the mobile networks.

claims.text: Platform verification claim: the guide asserts how Snapchat marks its official support account without specifying the exact badge/tick/username or acknowledging
claims.detail: Platform verification claim: the guide asserts how Snapchat marks its official support account without specifying the exact badge/tick/username or acknowledging that platform verification systems change. A reader relying on this description could trust the wrong account. Safe advice is to reach support from inside the app or Snapchat's official help centre.: "Snapchat's verified support account is clearly marked."
